unlanded.text: | **Blueprint** | The adaptable narrative of the desired finished product: destination, people, outcomes, experience, integrated design, cross-cutting qualities, lifecycle and non-goals. | It supports the design concept; it is not current status, an ADR inventory, a work queue, a glossary, or a proof archive. |
unlanded.note: Current release entries carry the definition and distinction.

unlanded.text: | **Spec** | A stable capability record containing scoped intent, requirements, decisions, implementation slices, acceptance, verification, evidence, and completion. | It combines the useful product and engineering roles often split between a PRD and technical spec. |
unlanded.note: Current release entries carry the definition and distinction.

unlanded.text: | **Task** | A bounded executable slice within a Spec, recorded in its own `TASK.md` with state, proof, blockers and assigned stance. | It is temporary execution structure, not durable capability history. The older name **Ticket** and historical `TK-` IDs remain readable in retained records. |
unlanded.note: Current release entries carry the definition and distinction.

unlanded.text: | **Notepad** | A local, objective-scoped JSON working record with a compact editable current view and an append-oriented work record. Grilling records are notepads and therefore JSON. | It is not Canon or permanent history; preserve important material until reconciled. One objective may use several linked notes. |
unlanded.note: Current release entries.

unlanded.text: | **Jot** | A small source-linked Wiki capture of knowledge, owner intent, observations, proposals or unresolved questions, including correction history. | Shared topic context is recoverable from the Wiki; explicit private jots stay ignored and require local opt-in. A confirmed intention is not a verified result or instruction authority. Old JSON notepads remain readable. |
unlanded.note: Current release entries.

unlanded.text: | **Scoped handoff** | A separate local Markdown (`.md`) brief for a specified recipient, purpose, job and endpoint, selecting relevant Wiki context, legacy notes and source links. | The owner or an agent within its assigned role may initiate one. A pointer requires accessible, retained source data; preparation does not authorize the recipient's work. The [handoff procedure](workbench/skills/handoff/SKILL.md#transfer-procedure) owns transfer. |
unlanded.note: Current release entries.

unlanded.text: | **WBID** | A visible artifact identifier with a type prefix and value replacing a numeric portion. New Spec, Task, ADR and notepad values use uppercase `0-9A-Z`, minimum width four, and at least one letter. | Unique within type and Workbench, not globally. Short, widened or case variants of one collision key resolve to one record; existing numeric, short and mixed-case labels remain readable. Open Spec/Task widening uses explicit `widen-id`; historical numeric Tasks remain Spec-qualified. The `WB-` connection identity retains a separate base-62 format. |
unlanded.note: Current release entries.

unlanded.text: | **Stance** | The method and obligations for performing one assigned task within already established authority. | It is neither an identity nor an authority grant; switching stance creates no handoff. |
unlanded.note: The TASK row is covered by the **Task** entry.
